dedupe_keys.name: a context and template based data compression approach to improve resource constrained iot systems interoperability

description: Berzosa, Jorge and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented CTC method compresses text-based data formats for devices with restricted communication bandwidth, memory and processing capacity. It includes complementary deployment and integration mechanisms and evaluates XML and JSON representations in real and simulated IoT scenarios. Earlier method and EXI-comparison publications belong to the same algorithm family. This resource models communication-data representation and its resource implications in physical device networks. The abstract does not provide a reusable code location or establish performance for every network topology. Source-code availability remains unknown, and the deposit is not described as a general-purpose network simulator. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
